fieldData.awb---integration-feature-2:
Allergies by table number, in the kitchen at 4 pm

Every booking at Kinto Ramen asks about the nine major food allergens, with a box for anything else. At 4 pm the kitchen channel in Slack gets tonight's flagged tables with their seat times. Table 6 at 6:00 tops the list with a sesame allergy.
fieldData.awb---mockup-data: window.awbMockup = { coversPerSeating: "My bistro seats 52 and the kitchen can take 16 covers every 15 minutes. When a party asks for a time that would go over 16, show them the nearest earlier and later seatings that still fit the whole party, with how many covers are left in each. Put every booking on tonight's sheet for the host.", largeParties: "Any party over eight should not book a regular table. Send them to a private dining request instead. The room seats 24 and has a $1,500 food-and-beverage minimum. Ask for a $300 deposit through Stripe, then post the request in Slack so our events manager can approve it.", allergyNotes: "Ask every guest about the nine major food allergens with checkboxes, plus a free-text box for anything else. At 4 pm each day, post tonight's flagged tables to our kitchen channel in Slack, in seat-time order, with the table number and the allergy for each.", cancellations: "Email every guest 24 hours before their booking with Confirm and Cancel buttons. When a table cancels, put those covers back into the seating and email the next waitlist party that fits. Give them 20 minutes to claim the table, then offer it to the party after them." };
fieldData.afb---prompt: Build a restaurant reservation form that books tables by time and party size.

acrm---key-feature-3-image.alt: At 4 pm the Kinto Ramen kitchen channel gets tonight's allergy list, led by table 6 at 6:00 with a sesame allergy, then shellfish at 6:30 and peanuts at 7:45.
